Check the health and configuration of the /scan sensor hardware and its ROS driver for timing or data rate issues.
Review the /cmd_vel actuator node for robustness to upstream sensor timing faults and improve error handling or fallback behaviors.
Inspect the /tf transform broadcaster and consumers for resilience to missing or delayed sensor data, and consider adding diagnostics to catch upstream failures earlier.
